breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between the specified time integration methods. The original prompt incorrectly listed both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Strang splitting'. The ground truth correctly removes the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent, however, incorrectly combined the two conflicting instructions, stating 'Implement Strang splitting time integration with explicit forward Euler,' which perpetuates the user's error.
